title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Provides ₹6000 per year to eligible farmers in 3 installments.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with land ownership.
benefits: Direct income support ₹6000/year.

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Provides free health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care.
eligibility: Families identified as deprived/rural and urban workers as per SECC data.
benefits: Cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance for construction of pucca houses to rural households.
eligibility: Households without pucca house, as per SECC data.
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh assistance per unit (in plain areas).

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Housing scheme for urban poor through credit-linked subsidy, in-situ slum redevelopment, etc.
eligibility: EWS/LIG categories; women, SC/ST, minorities priority.
benefits: Subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.67 lakh; affordable houses.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days of assured wage employment; unemployment allowance.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme to protect farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops, including sharecroppers and tenants.
benefits: Low premium (1.5-2% of sum insured) with high coverage.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
eligibility: BPL women, SC/ST, forest dwellers, etc.
benefits: Free LPG connection with financial assistance.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G)
description: Aims to make rural India open defecation free and improve solid waste management.
eligibility: All rural households for toilet construction.
benefits: Financial assistance for toilet construction; behavioral change.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash support to pregnant and lactating mothers.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers (first live child).
benefits: ₹5,000 in installments; conditional cash transfer.

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: National initiative to address gender imbalance and promote education of girls.
eligibility: Girl children and their families.
benefits: Awareness campaigns, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, etc.

title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: Maharashtra state health insurance scheme providing cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh per family.
eligibility: Families with annual income up to ₹1 lakh (rural) or ₹1.5 lakh (urban).
benefits: Cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals; covers 971 procedures.

title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Financial assistance scheme for eligible women in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Women aged 21-60 years with family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month as financial aid.

title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Shetkari Sanman Yojana
description: State scheme to provide financial assistance to farmers to supplement PM-Kisan.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with land up to 2 hectares.
benefits: Additional ₹6,000 per year in two installments.

title: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan
description: State flagship water conservation scheme to make villages water-sufficient.
eligibility: All villages in Maharashtra with water scarcity.
benefits: Construction of check dams, farm ponds, and recharge structures.

title: Shiv Bhojan Thali
description: Provides subsidized nutritious meals at low cost to the needy.
eligibility: All citizens, particularly economically weaker sections.
benefits: Meal at ₹10 per plate (originally ₹5, later revised).

title: Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UMED)
description: Aims to reduce poverty by strengthening self-help groups and livelihood opportunities.
eligibility: Rural poor women, SHGs, and vulnerable communities.
benefits: Capacity building, credit linkages, skill training, and employment.

title: District Mineral Foundation (DMF) - Nagpur District Welfare Scheme
description: District-level schemes funded by mining royalties for development and welfare in mining-affected areas.
eligibility: Residents of villages/talukas affected by mining activities.
benefits: Infrastructure, health, education, drinking water projects.

title: District Skill Development Mission (DSDM) - Pune
description: District-level skill training and placement scheme for youth.
eligibility: Youth (18-35 years) with minimum 8th pass; preference to BPL families.
benefits: Free skill training, certification, and job placement support.

title: Taluka Krishi Vikas Yojana (TKVV)
description: Taluka-level scheme to promote modern farming techniques and input subsidies.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers in the respective taluka.
benefits: Subsidy on seeds, fertilizers, farm machinery; demonstration plots.

title: Taluka Sports Development Scheme
description: Promotes sports infrastructure and talent at taluka level.
eligibility: Students and youth in the taluka area.
benefits: Grants for sports equipment, coaching, and organizing competitions.

title: Gram Panchayat Development Plan (GPDP) Scheme
description: Village-level participatory planning for local development using 14th Finance Commission funds.
eligibility: All gram panchayats and residents.
benefits: Funds for local infrastructure, sanitation, streetlights, water supply.

title: Village Water Supply and Sanitation Scheme (VWSS)
description: Village-level scheme to provide piped water supply and improve sanitation facilities.
eligibility: All households in the village; priority to SC/ST colonies.
benefits: Piped water connections, community toilets, soak pits.

title: Village Solar Street Light Initiative
description: Installation of solar street lights in villages to improve safety and reduce carbon footprint.
eligibility: Villages with no existing street lighting infrastructure.
benefits: Free installation and maintenance for 5 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Central scheme for food processing and agro infrastructure development.
eligibility: Food processing units, cooperatives, FPOs, entrepreneurs.
benefits: Financial assistance for infrastructure, cold chains, and mega food parks.

title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
description: Central scheme to promote self-employment and organization of rural poor women.
eligibility: Rural poor women, SHGs.
benefits: Interest subsidy, revolving fund, community investment fund.

title: Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana (MGAY)
description: Maharashtra state scheme to provide housing for rural poor not covered under PMAY-G.
eligibility: Rural households without pucca house and not availing central scheme.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1.20 lakh for house construction.

title: District Innovation Fund (DIF) - Aurangabad
description: District-level fund to support innovative projects in education, health, and infrastructure.
eligibility: Schools, colleges, NGOs, and local bodies in the district.
benefits: Grants up to ₹10 lakh for innovative pilot projects.

title: Taluka Library Development Scheme
description: Taluka-level initiative to upgrade public libraries and promote reading.
eligibility: Public libraries and reading rooms in the taluka.
benefits: Financial assistance for books, furniture, and digital resources.

title: Village Entrepreneurship Development Program (VEDP)
description: Village-level scheme to support small businesses and self-employment.
eligibility: Village residents with a business idea; SHG members preferred.
benefits: Seed capital, training, and mentorship for micro-enterprises.
